description: Header file defining the VideoDecoder class for DAV1D video decoding within the starboard shared library, including class members, methods, and dependencies.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a DAV1D-based video decoder for the starboard platform, managing decoding process, output, and error handling.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VideoDecoder with codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of frames to preroll before playback.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of cached frames.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target for rendering.
